codeReview.summary: The worker successfully refactored sale-sync.race.test.ts to use mock repositories instead of real database connections. The fix addresses the 'db.delete is not a function' error that was occurring because the test was attempting to connect to a real Neon PostgreSQL database. The refactored test now uses vitest mocks (mockSaleRepo, mockPaymentRepo) following the same pattern as multi-device.race.test.ts. All 3 test cases (version conflict detection, sequential updates with correct version, and version check in updateWithItems) are preserved and pass correctly.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The test follows the established backend pattern of using mock repositories for unit tests rather than real database connections. This is consistent with multi-device.race.test.ts and should be documented as the preferred pattern for sync handler tests.
